features.timing: log10 of the median, mean, std, min, max of the 31 intervals between the window's 32 reports (seconds, floor 1e-06 s)
features.rssi: mean and standard deviation of the 32 RSSI values (column rssi)
features.note: no angle, format, SNR byte, body length or address; the window is r_common's (32 decodable reports of one session)

part1_timing_rssi.observer: r_eval's 1-NN on the z-scored features (fitted on all windows), same episodes for every feature set
part1_timing_rssi.reference: i.i.d. standard normal features of the same width, same episodes (reference_* and *_minus_reference); null_noise = r_rotation's 320-d noise table

peak_rss_note: high-water mark of the process when the part ended; the part's own peak when it ran alone (--part N)

bodies.rot_group_cb42_n234: rotation per group, 4/2 bits, 234 tone groups
bodies.rot_group: rotation per group at each device's own codebook
bodies.rot_group_cb42_n234+one_format+no_snr: the first with a constant format column and no SNR field (r_round3_checks part 2, snr_step=removed)

part5_equivalence.reference: r_rotation's pure-noise table on the same episodes (for the invariant observer its 64-d noise), same scaling
part5_equivalence.tost: equivalence within +-m holds at alpha when the 1 - 2 alpha percentile interval of the paired bootstrap difference lies inside (-m, m); smallest_equivalence_margin is the larger absolute end of that interval, upper_bound_one_sided its upper end

scalings.stored: z-score fitted on all windows (of the five devices in the rerun, of the six in the same-episode variant)
scalings.enrolled: z-score fitted on the windows enrolled in the decision

variants.rerun_five_devices: r_eval's protocol, grids and seed on the window table without the device: its own draws
variants.same_episodes_five_devices: r_eval's stored episodes with the device's queries dropped and the device taken out of every gallery: the decisions of the paper's run
variants.six_devices: the stored run, recomputed (checks: against r_eval_checks.json)

metric.pairs: two reports of two different held-out positions per pair, 3000 pairs per seed, every one of the 59 tone groups
metric.channel: each user is one stream on its true first right-singular vector v_u (the unquantised column of the dataset): it receives y_u = v_u^H x + n_u with unit noise power; the dataset holds no singular values, so both users have unit channel gain
metric.precoder: W = F (F^H F)^+ with F = [v_hat_a, v_hat_b] the fed-back first columns as the access point decodes them (after Q_k for the rotation, one Q_k per group shared by the pair), columns scaled to unit norm, power split equally
metric.sinr: SINR_u = (P/2) |v_u^H w_u|^2 / (1 + (P/2) |v_u^H w_j|^2), P = 20 dB over the noise
metric.sum_rate: sum over the two users of log2(1 + SINR_u), bit/s/Hz, mean over pairs and groups
metric.sum_rate_ratio: sum_rate / sum_rate of true_vectors_zf (same pairs, per seed)
metric.sinr_db: mean over users, pairs and groups of 10 log10 SINR_u; sinr_db_low = its 5th percentile
metric.sinr_loss_db: sinr_db of true_vectors_zf minus sinr_db of the cell (per seed)

scopes.least_correlated_quarter: per seed, the 0.25 of the pairs with the lowest true_vector_correlation, as an access point that chooses whom to serve together would pair

metric.true_vector_correlation: |v_a^H v_b|^2 of the two true vectors, mean over groups and pairs

references.true_vectors_zf: zero-forcing on the unquantised true vectors (no interference left)
references.true_vectors_mrt: no nulling: each user's beam is its true vector

metric.gain_col1: single-user gain |v_hat^H v|^2 of the same fed-back vectors, mean over both users
metric.fed_back_vectors_coincide: share of (pair, group) whose two fed-back vectors are parallel, served by the pseudo-inverse

part2_deeper_codebooks.protocol: held-out positions, cosine 1-NN, K = 1; scaled = features standardised on the calibration positions quantised at the same codebook, raw = no scaling, invariant = |V_k^H V_0| (joint_defense_eval's nn1_inv); gain = |v_hat_1^H v_1|^2 against the unquantised V, the access point undoing Q for the rotations
part2_deeper_codebooks.codebook_note: joint_defense_common's functions with HE_B_PHI, HE_B_PSI and B_HEADLINE set to the codebook; random streams are those of the 4/2 runs, so the codebooks share their draws

clauses.at_chance: largest one-sided 95 % bound over seeds of the three observers at T = 1 <= chance + margin

part3_five_rooms.split: per room: the first round(n_positions / 2) position labels calibrate (features standardised on them), the others are enrolled and queried; Conference Room 1 keeps joint_defense_eval's 20 / 19
